## What changes for users?

Describe the problem and the resulting behaviour. Link the related issue or discussion, if there is one.

## Scope

Which public source version or documentation does this change apply to?

<!--
The public desktop/ tree currently contains VibeZ 3. The separate V4 Alpha
implementation is not in this repository's source archives. For V4 implementation
work, first agree the exact accessible source and base branch in an issue.
Documentation, reproducible reports and testing are welcome for both versions.
Do not attach private V4 source, account data or signing keys to this pull request.

## Validation

What did you test, on which operating system? Include a screenshot for visible changes when useful. If you could not test something, say so.

- [ ] This change is limited to the stated problem.
- [ ] I have removed passwords, tokens and personal data from the changes and attachments.

The maintainer reviews and publishes changes. Opening a pull request does not publish an app update.
